dopamine_loop.definition: The cycle in which unpredictable rewards (likes, new content) train the brain to seek the next stimulus repeatedly.

intel_expertise.definition: Deep skill and knowledge in one narrow field, built up over years of practice.
intel_expertise.example: Her expertise on the press line made her the only person who could set the machine up.

nocebo_effect.definition: The worsening of symptoms or the appearance of side effects because a person expects them.

snack.definition: A small amount of food that you eat between two meals.
snack.example: I brought a snack to school for break time.
